chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no milk by which the infant is nursed that is greater in blessing upon him than the milk of its mother.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Ali ibn Abi Talib)

ai.seo_question: What is the most blessed source of milk for an infant according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) narrates from Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) that among all sources of nourishment for an infant, the mother's milk holds the greatest blessing. This hadith highlights the spiritual and physical superiority of breast milk, encouraging mothers to nurse their children. Within Shia scholarship, this narration is often cited to underscore the sanctity of the maternal bond and the divine wisdom embedded in natural feeding, reinforcing the practice as both a physical necessity and a spiritual act of care.
